frequency_question: How often does the Department of Education terminate an accreditor's recognition when formal reviews are initiated under compliance pressure?
membership_rule: Includes formal review proceedings of national or professional accrediting agencies by the Department of Education where derecognition was actively considered. Excludes voluntary relinquishments.

cases.name: American College of Nurse Midwives (ACNM) Division of Accreditation
Accrediting Council for Independent Colleges and Schools (ACICS)

provenance_note: claims 15 cases from only 3 named (5.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 3 named key cases; estimated 15 major contested reviews total in the timeframe
known_gaps: Lower-level compliance warnings that did not reach formal revocation hearings are excluded.
skeleton: Formal Department of Education recognition review cycles for national and specialized accreditors over three decades
multiplier: 2 revocations out of approximately 15 major contested compliance reviews
validity_reason: Relies on statutory and regulatory frameworks for agency recognition which remain stable across typical administrative cycles.
